summary: Document asynchronous catch-up recovery and liveness limits with deterministic lifecycle controls

replay.detail: Documentation and tests add no replay or automatic recovery. Queue processing is ordered by local store_index and applies canonical contribution rank.

schema.detail: No additional schema or trigger changes.

rules.detail: Admission, complete-prefix certification and canonical rank rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No Rust interface or production activation changes.

manual.detail: IVM_ASYNCHRONOUS.md now explicitly describes receiver ownership, global-prefix wait starvation, panic diagnostics and unbounded stop; owners share one Publisher per Store.

recovery.detail: There is no implemented recovery for capture/quota/oversized-input fences. Poison operator panics roll back and repeat on restart. Production adoption requires a defined recovery or prevention contract; these controls qualify the existing fail-closed behavior only.
